subject: nwEngland spatial polygon in the INLA package

messages.subject: nwEngland spatial polygon in the INLA package
parts:
Dear r-inla people,

 

I was trying to use the New England example on the new r-inla.org website

 

https://sites.google.com/a/r-inla.org/www/examples/case-studies/martino-akerkar-and-rue-2010/leukemia-example

 

(with the “Besag” model)

 

Now the links “dataset”  and “graph.file” seem corrupted on this page.

 

In any case I found the “Leuk” dataset within the INLA package,  which also contains the spatial polygon object nwEngland.  So after some searching on your FAQ page, I gather that

 

poly2nb(nwEngland) 

 

should give me the adjacency matrix.  But this function throws an error:

 

Error in sum(sapply(foundInBox, length)) :

  Invalid ‘type’ (list) of argument. 

 

I did some further searching and as far as I can see the poly2nb function should be able to deal with spatial polygons.  I couldn’t find in the inla.pdf info how to do it either.

 

Any suggestion what I am overlooking?

 

Best,

Bart
